_comment: Ray-mode worker registry. Used by spawn_workers.py when USE_RAY=true. HTTP-mode workers (GatewayService) still use expert_machine_mapping.json — this file has no url/port fields so the two configs cannot be confused.

_schema.workers.<id>.enabled: Set to false to skip spawning this worker (use when the machine is not yet in the Ray cluster).
_schema.workers.<id>.base_model_key: Must match a key in experts_registry.json base_models section
_schema.workers.<id>.num_replicas: How many Ray Actor replicas to spawn for this model. >1 enables round-robin load balancing across replicas (each replica holds the full model on its own GPU).
_schema.workers.<id>.num_gpus: GPU slots required per actor. 1 = one full GPU (standard). Fractional values allowed if multiple models share a GPU.
_schema.workers.<id>.placement_group_strategy: Optional Ray placement group strategy: STRICT_PACK | PACK | SPREAD | STRICT_SPREAD. Omit to let Ray schedule freely.

worker-0.note: Primary English finance worker (Llama-2-7B). csetuf07 GPU 0.

worker-1.note: Spanish / Japanese sentiment rating (Qwen2.5-7B). csetuf14 GPU 0.

worker-4.note: 4-bit quantised Mistral (machine-4, GPU 0). Set enabled=true when machine joins cluster.
